data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next catch, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons now, we can catch 50 tons between us and leave 50 to double back to 100 next month. How about we each take 10 tons this month? That’s $10,000 apiece, and we can check our catches together afterward and agree on next month’s limits. John, what do you think?
